article.story: ATLANTA -- — Cliff Davis had 27 points in James Madison's 80-65 win against Georgia State on Saturday. Davis shot 10 of 14 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 6 from the line for the Dukes (16-13, 8-8 Sun Belt Conference). Gabe Newhof scored 18 points while shooting 8 of 10 from the field and 2 for 5 from the line, and added five rebounds. Micah Tucker finished with 22 points for the Panthers (10-19, 7-9). Georgia State also got 19 points, six rebounds and three steals from Jelani Hamilton. Malachi Brown also had 11 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
